normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter exists only to feed the onlyFrozen status check applied to the caller in pool entrypoints
The value parameter is the staged amount manipulated by deposit and has no independent identity in the graph
The token parameter only selects the asset moved by the emergencyWithdraw external transfer
The owner parameter is bound to the recovered signer inside permit
The spender parameter is the approval target produced by permit
The deadline parameter is only used in the permit timestamp check
newPhantom is a transient internal result of the bond arithmetic and belongs to the bond function node
newClaimable is a transient internal result of the unbond arithmetic and belongs to the unbond function node
lessPhantom is a transient internal result of the unbond arithmetic and belongs to the unbond function node
timeElapsed is a transient internal result of the timestamp delta computation inside updatePrice
newUniv2 is the transient minted-liquidity result consumed by the provide accounting
